working_definition: Author type 'Dm3a' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Dm3 neuron with posterior-ventrally oriented dendrites (Ozel et al., 2021). It can be distinguished from Dm3b based on its lack of bi expression (Ozel et al., 2021).

justification: 'Dm3a' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00052303 'distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm3a'.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052303 'distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm3a' (exact match).
